answer: Plant every new agent in a verification orchard before it can trade. First, it locks a 500 POA bond for a sapling identity. Second, over 30 days it must finish 20 microtasks, each checked by two peers. Third, every failed task prunes 25 POA; three failures burn the bond and compost the identity. After 30 clean days it graduates to full trading rights. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 5,000,000 POA and demands 200,000 verified tasks plus 30 days of work, a $500,000 bill before one fake can trade. Like an orchard on a ridge above the ocean, only trees bearing real fruit earn a place in the sun.
